bug_summary: plpgsqlの列参照解決が、任意の先頭修飾子(テーブルエイリアス等)を無条件に剥がして変数名と照合してしまい、t.col という参照が同名のplpgsql変数に化けて誤った値を読んでいた
pr_title: Generalize plpgsql qualified column reference lookup
pr_description: `plpgsql_pre_column_ref` only tried the full dotted name and, failing that, a single stripped leading label, which only handles references qualified by at most one block label. This generalizes the lookup to try each trailing suffix of the dotted name, longest first, so more deeply nested qualification resolves against the param map the same way, and removes the block-label bookkeeping (`labels` set and the `with_labels` constructor) that the single-strip approach needed.
